summary: The 'HTML' utility provides methods for rendering HTML fragments and generating JavaScript links (for new windows or popups) with specific parameters, icons, and titles. It streamlines the construction of anchor and span elements for UI, supports link hashing for security or consistency, and contains utility helpers for formatting and disabling elements.
purpose: To facilitate consistent, secure, and flexible rendering of HTML snippets—especially dynamic links and icons—in a .NET-based web application.
actors: System/Server-side code (invoking the HTML static methods)

workflows.name: Generate a new window link with icon and hashed URL
steps: Call newWindowLink with session, page, parameters, icon name, and icon title.
Iterate through paramNames/paramValues, appending to URL as needed.
If an icon is specified, generate a span with appropriate class and title.
Return complete anchor HTML with embedded onclick JavaScript.
For placement or calendar grid links, call newWindowDetails or newWindowCalendarGrid with specific parameters.
Insert URL hash into link URL with Hashing.AddURLHash.

workflows.name: Disable an element for display
steps: Call disableElement with the element string.
Wrap the element in a span with 'disabledtext' class.

workflows.name: Format text with HTML line breaks
steps: Call translateNewLines with a text string.

business_rules: If a parameter name is blank, it is skipped when constructing query string.
For role-based parameterization, set UserType depending on Role (PC or RC).
The 'CurrentPage' parameter does not affect the URL hash and is appended after hashing if present.
If AmendmentExists, modify icon class and title to reflect changes.
For group vs. individual calendar grids, change page name and icon/title accordingly.
validations: Check for string.IsNullOrEmpty before rendering icons or processing text.
Only hash URLs if they are non-empty and valid for the hashing function.
calculations: Dynamic assignment of query parameters for URLs based on method arguments.
Construction of CSS classes and icon tooltips using input values and resources.
conditions: Switch behavior for 'GroupShiftSchedule' and 'AmendmentExists' to dictate UI icons/text.
If 'currentPage' is non-blank, append it to the URL after hashing.
If 'ReadOnly' is true or Role is DC, add ReadOnly parameter.
system_behavior: Generates anchor tags with JavaScript onclick events to launch new windows with constructed URLs.
Uses span elements instead of images for icons.
Replaces line breaks in text with HTML line breaks for display purposes.
dependencies: HSPnet.Framework (for session, roles, and possibly database access)
exceptions: If text or element input is null or empty, returns empty string for display.
If page parameters are invalid or missing, URLs may lack those components but will not throw errors.
content_gaps: No example output HTML is given for methods.
Specific details of resource lookups, role constants, and hashing implementation are not present.
Database utility and Hashing functions are referenced but not defined in this content.
